description: Defines the ClientCache class which manages a cache of buffer handles between SurfaceFlinger clients and the SurfaceFlinger process in Android. It includes methods for adding, erasing, retrieving buffers, and managing cache recipients.

classes.name: ClientCache
classes.description: Manages a cache of buffer handles for SurfaceFlinger clients, including adding, removing, retrieving buffers, and handling cache recipients.

classes.name: ClientCache::ErasedRecipient
classes.description: Interface for recipients notified when a buffer is erased from the cache.

classes.name: ClientCache::CacheDeathRecipient
classes.description: Handles death notifications for binder processes related to the cache.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a buffer to the cache, returns an expected containing ExternalTexture or an error.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes a buffer from the cache by cacheId.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a buffer from the cache by cacheId.

methods.name: setRenderEngine
methods.description: Sets the RenderEngine instance used by the cache.

methods.name: removeProcess
methods.description: Removes all cache entries associated with a process token.

methods.name: registerErasedRecipient
methods.description: Registers a recipient to be notified when a buffer is erased.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the current state of the cache for debugging.

methods.name: binderDied
methods.description: Callback invoked when a binder process dies.
